name: COD10K
ability_definition: The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material.

task_realism.reasoning: Finding an object that blends into similar-looking surroundings is the perceptual core of real work such as spotting camouflaged targets in surveillance, finding defects on textured surfaces, locating lesions in medical images, and screening baggage. However, COD10K images are mostly natural photos of animals camouflaged in their habitats. These are not the domain-specific scenes workers actually search, where the 'known pattern' is usually a defined defect, threat, or anomaly type.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Models are fine-tuned on in-distribution training splits (CAMO+COD10K) and scored offline on static, curated images. There is no time pressure, no cost asymmetry between misses and false alarms, and no need to judge whether a target is present at all, since nearly every image contains one. There is also no distribution shift of the kind found in real inspection or screening, where target prevalence is low and target appearance varies.

construct_coverage.reasoning: The benchmark covers only the visual slice of an ability that O*NET defines as including figures, objects, words, and sounds. The target is class-agnostic salient-but-camouflaged segmentation, not detection of a specified, known template among distractors. So the 'known pattern' element of the definition is only implicit. It also excludes target-absent trials and embedded-figure-style line patterns.

format_match.reasoning: Inputs are real photographs, and outputs are pixel-level masks. This fairly closely resembles real work outputs such as localizing and delineating a found object, and is far more natural than forced-choice or toy grids. Real workflows, however, often need a present/absent decision, a bounding box, or a flagged report instead of dense segmentation. The S-measure metric also rewards structural similarity rather than operational hit/miss outcomes.

transferability_reasoning: COD10K directly exercises the visual core of Flexibility of Closure, since it requires separating a concealed object from similar-looking surroundings, and it uses realistic images and localization outputs. Transfer is limited for three reasons. First, it is visual only and class-agnostic, with no explicit known target. Second, it is dominated by natural animal imagery rather than workplace domains. Third, testing is offline and in-distribution, with no target-absent cases or operational stakes.

2020.metric: Structure-measure S-alpha on the COD10K test set (2,026 images), scale 0-1, higher is better
2020.human_reference: General adult population doing careful visual search and outlining on still images, since Flexibility of Closure is a general perceptual ability used across many jobs

2021.metric: weighted F-measure (F^w_β) on COD10K-Test, 0.686 written as a percentage
2021.human_reference: General adult workforce performing visual search for a hidden or camouflaged target. Flexibility of closure is a broad perceptual ability, not a specialist skill. The assumed setting is a typical adult with reasonable viewing time who is told a concealed object is present, marking its extent.

2022.metric: S-measure (Sα, structure similarity from 0 to 1; higher is better)
2022.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal vision. Flexibility of Closure is a broad perceptual ability used in inspection, search, and surveillance-type work, not a specialist skill.

2023.metric: S-measure (structure measure, 0-1 scale, higher is better) on the COD10K test set (2,026 images)
2023.human_reference: General adult workforce doing careful visual search or inspection (for example image annotators, visual inspectors), working without time pressure

2024.metric: S-measure (structure similarity, 0-1 scale; higher is better)
2024.human_reference: General adult workforce performing careful visual search and localization, such as inspection, surveillance or image-review workers, with adequate viewing time and knowledge that a concealed object is present
